title: At a tangent point the normalised ball averages of β(S) tend to β(T) (corrected η_V^(x)(β) = β(T_x))
statement: Let V be an n-varifold on the open set U ⊆ ℝ^N, x ∈ ℝ^N, T ∈ G(N,n) and θ ∈ ℝ, and suppose V has tangent plane T with multiplicity θ at x in the sense of Simon Ch. 8, Def. 1.1 (HasTangentPlane V x T θ: x ∈ U, θ > 0, and ∫ f dV_{x,t} → θ ∫ f dv(T) as t ↓ 0 for every f ∈ C_c(ℝ^N × G(N,n)), where V_{x,t} = rescaledMeasure V x t and v(T) = planeVarifoldMeasure T). Then for every continuous β : G(N,n) → ℝ, (∫_{Gₙ(B_ρ(x))} β(S) dV(y,S)) / μ_V(B_ρ(x)) → β(T) as ρ ↓ 0, where B_ρ(x) is the closed ball, Gₙ(A) = A × G(N,n), μ_V = V.weight, and μ_V(B_ρ(x)) is taken as a real number (ENNReal.toReal).
lean_statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclidean N)) (V : Varifold N n U) (x : Euclidean N) (T : Grassmannian N n) (θ : ℝ), HasTangentPlane V x T θ → ∀ β : C(Grassmannian N n, ℝ), Tendsto (fun ρ : ℝ ↦ (∫ z in closedBall x ρ ×ˢ (univ : Set (Grassmannian N n)), β z.2 ∂V.measure) / (V.weight (closedBall x ρ)).toReal) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 (β T))
